topics.title: Subject-Verb Agreement
topics.lesson: Verb harus cocok dengan subjek utama, bukan kata yang dekat dengannya. The results of the study are clear. Ingat: each, every, either, neither + of → verb tunggal. The number of → tunggal, a number of → jamak.
topics.trap: Frasa 'of the ...' atau 'in the ...' di tengah kalimat sengaja dipasang untuk mengecoh. Coret dulu frasa itu, cari subjeknya.

topics.title: Tenses
topics.lesson: Past perfect (had + V3) untuk kejadian yang terjadi lebih dulu dari kejadian lampau lain. Present perfect (has/have + V3) dipakai dengan since, for, already, yet. Past continuous untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat aksi lain memotong.
topics.trap: Kata kunci waktu (since, by the time, when) hampir selalu menentukan jawaban. Cari kata itu dulu.

topics.title: Parallelism
topics.lesson: Item dalam daftar atau pasangan (and, or, but, not only...but also) harus berbentuk sama: semua V-ing, semua to-infinitive, semua kata dasar, atau semua kata benda.
topics.trap: Lihat item pertama di daftar, lalu samakan item terakhir dengannya. Jawaban yang 'terdengar enak' sering salah.

topics.title: Conditionals
topics.lesson: Type 1: If + present, will + V1. Type 2: If + were/V2, would + V1. Type 3: If + had + V3, would have + V3. Type 3 bisa diinversi: Had I known, ...
topics.trap: Pada Type 2, 'were' dipakai untuk semua subjek (If I were, If she were). 'Was' biasanya jebakan.

questions.q: The results of the experiment ____ surprising.
Neither the teacher nor the students ____ ready.
questions.e: Pada neither...nor, verb mengikuti subjek yang terdekat: students (jamak) → are.

questions.q: Each of the books ____ a different cover.
questions.e: Each of + kata benda jamak tetap memakai verb tunggal: has.

questions.q: The number of students ____ increasing every year.
questions.e: The number of = tunggal → is. (A number of = jamak.)

questions.q: By the time we arrived, the movie ____.
questions.e: By the time + past → kejadian sebelumnya memakai past perfect: had already started.

questions.q: I ____ TV when the phone rang.
questions.e: Aksi yang sedang berlangsung lalu dipotong aksi lain → past continuous: was watching.

questions.q: Tomorrow at this time, we ____ on the beach.
questions.e: 'Tomorrow at this time' = aksi berlangsung di masa depan → will be lying.
Item sebelumnya V-ing, jadi item terakhir juga V-ing: reading.

questions.q: The job requires patience, creativity, and ____.
He is not only intelligent but also ____.
To succeed, you must study hard, sleep well, and ____ healthy food.
questions.e: Setelah must, semua verb berbentuk dasar: study, sleep, eat.

questions.q: If I ____ rich, I would travel the world.
If she had studied harder, she ____ the test.
If it rains tomorrow, we ____ at home.
____ I known the answer, I would have told you.
questions.e: Inversi Type 3: Had + subjek + V3 menggantikan 'If I had known'.
